compound for a wide range of applications. Epoxy Metal Filler fulfils a wide range of filling and bonding

automotive industry as a paint carrier system and tin replacement. Fast curing (less than 60 minutes at
elevated temperature) and easy machinability allow a cost-effective application.

and the correct mixing in the static mixing coil guarantee the product characteristics and the consistent
quality during the processing of the material.
